title: Total internal reflection (পূর্ণ অভ্যন্তরীণ প্রতিফলন)
placement: Book page 248, topic 9.2 পূর্ণ অভ্যন্তরীণ প্রতিফলন, চিত্র ৯.০৬ (the three cases), ৯.০৭ (a right-angle prism as a mirror) and ৯.০৮, with the সংকট কোণ examples (pp. 248–251).
description: Total internal reflection (pages 248–251, topic 9.2). The school's optical disc on a plain sand table in a calm deep-blue setting: a white disc printed in degrees, a semicircular glass block at its centre with its flat face up (glass, the dense medium, below; the light medium above, as চিত্র ৯.০৬), and a ray box clamped to the rim, aimed at the centre O of the flat face, so the light enters the curved face along a radius and bends only at O. Five steps, one tap each, slow: (1) the light on at θ₂ = 30°: the refracted ray bends away from the normal (θ₁ = 48.6°), a faint reflected ray (Fresnel, about 5 %); (2) the source turns to the critical angle θc = 41.8°: θ₁ reaches 90° and the ray grazes the surface (ক্রান্তি কোণ বা সংকট কোণ, sin θc = n₁/n₂); (3) on to 60°: nothing leaves, all of it is reflected (পূর্ণ অভ্যন্তরীণ প্রতিফলন); (4) the book's question: a clear cell of water on the flat face, θc grows to 62.5°, and at 45° light now leaves into the water; (5) চিত্র ৯.০৭: a right-angle glass prism turns the light by 90° at 45° incidence, as a mirror. From step 1 the student turns the source (a handle on the rim, or the arrow keys); rays are traced exactly (Snell's law at O, radial through the curved faces), each as wide as the share of light it carries. The panel: a calm intro card, then a lead-in line, the live result, the rule in the book's words, the formula, and a live graph of θ₁ and the reflected part against θ₂ (θ₁ climbs to 90° at θc, then 'প্রতিসরণ নেই'; the reflected part jumps to 100 %). Glass is taken as n = 1.50 so θc is the book's 41.8° (NOTES.md). Test: five questions (which way the ray bends, reading θc off the disc, 70°, water at 50°, the prism). Phone-first, Bangla and English.
